title: Navigation menu on the settings window

next_action.label: Suggest closing as resolved
next_action.reason: The reporter says the UI change removed the condition needed to reproduce the issue.

judgment.rationale: The reporter confirmed on 2024-10-08 that the navigation menu is now always expanded and the blank-label issue can no longer be reproduced. No remaining defect is established by the thread.
evidence: Original report describes blank navigation labels on a fresh install with version 0.68.0.
A maintainer said they could not reproduce it in 2023.
After a maintainer asked in October 2024 about newer WinUI versions, the reporter said the menu is always expanded and the issue cannot be reproduced.
No linked fix PR was found in the issue timeline or PR search.
judgment.recommended_action: Close as no longer reproducible after the Settings navigation UI change.

fix_assessment.rationale: The reporter confirms the original failure is no longer reproducible after the Settings UI changed; no new code fix is indicated.

issue_context.summary: A blank-label Settings navigation issue from version 0.68.0 appears obsolete: after the menu became always expanded, the reporter could no longer reproduce it.
known_information: Original report says a fresh install and opening Settings from the welcome window could show an expanded menu with blank labels.
Reporter says closing and reopening the menu restored its text.
After a maintainer asked whether newer WinUI versions changed behavior, the reporter said the menu is now always expanded and they cannot reproduce it.
inferences: The current navigation presentation appears to avoid the original collapsed/expanded transition.
No specific fixing commit is identified in the public thread.
issue_context.analysis: The original failure depended on a menu transition the reporter says no longer exists. Since the reporter explicitly cannot reproduce it, a close suggestion is more accurate than speculative implementation work.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue, all three comments, screenshot reference, labels, assignees, and live updatedAt.
Confirmed the latest reporter comment answers the maintainer request and says the issue cannot be reproduced.
Searched related PowerToys PRs by issue number; no linked fix found.

actions.label: Suggest closing as no longer reproducible

comment.body: Thanks for confirming that the Settings navigation menu is now always expanded and you can no longer reproduce the blank-label behavior. Since the original menu transition no longer occurs and no current failure is reported, this appears resolved in current behavior. Please close this issue as no longer reproducible.
